candidates.proposal_rationale: The only captured measurement is the rank-eligible baseline: cell_area_um2=161954, setup_slack_ns=0.19292, hold_slack_ns=0.114491, and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations. No later evaluation or feedback is captured. This action combination is untried. Retain the qualified physical settings because setup headroom is small; avoid adding area-mapping timing risk or repair overhead without evidence. Enable the proved exact signed 18-bit reduction to target redundant arithmetic area and switching, and operand isolation to suppress multiplier input activity except when accepting requests, preserving the registered cycle contract. Isolation adds gates, capacitance and possible input-path delay; width reduction may offset these costs, but synthesis may already remove redundant width and CPU activity may limit total benefit. These are hypotheses, not measured improvements. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(Ew/Ebaseline_w) over DOT64, GEMM8 and CONV3, whose baseline energy_j values are 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6 and 1.1542462882162743e-6. Die area and estimated timing do not establish Q. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup/hold slack, electrical violations, each workload energy_j, area_ratio, energy_ratio and score; verify activity/parasitic annotation and correctness at the fixed 10526 ps period. Interpret energies within the frozen Liberty/zero-delay post-route activity/extracted-SPEF scope, without SDF glitch or silicon-power claims. Retain all failures, evaluation costs and the best qualified result; no candidate PPA result is available yet.

candidates.proposal_rationale: Captured evaluation 1 at utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=0 with both RTL actions reports cell_area_um2=160081 versus baseline 161954 (about 1.16% lower), setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439 versus +0.19292, hold_slack_ns=+0.0945523, and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations. It failed physical_qualified and rank_eligible with failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing]; energy_j and estimated_power_w are empty and no postprocessing commands ran. Its Q is therefore unavailable, not improved. The earlier passing review established proposal admissibility only. Choose the unseen combination utilization=30 with both actions retained, changing one physical parameter to test additional placement room after the timing failure. Lower utilization may ease congestion and placement competition but can lengthen wires, enlarge the clock network, and increase buffering and workload energy; no critical-path evidence establishes the failure cause or guarantees recovery. Keep density=0.55 and timing-oriented abc_area=0; zero electrical violations provide no evidence to increase repair_margin above 0. Retain proved request-gated multiplier operand isolation and exact signed 18-bit reduction with 32-bit sign extension and unchanged cycle contract. Their combined area result motivates retaining them, while isolation overhead and physical variability remain risks. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(Ew/Ebaseline_w), with baseline DOT64/GEMM8/CONV3 energies 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6, 1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Larger empty floorplan and a timing estimate do not establish improvement. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j and estimated_power_w, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, and physical/postprocess/total costs. Require the frozen correctness, timing, electrical and annotation checks at 10526 ps before ranking; assess Q against 1.0 and 0.98 only with qualified measurements. Energy scope remains Liberty estimates using zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, with no SDF-glitch or silicon-power claim. Retain evaluation 1 and its 3156.5922689560684 s total cost, including 3156.5922685480327 s physical time; its elapsed_search_seconds=3321.2583581329673 includes EDA and does not establish remaining agent budget. One of three candidate evaluations is captured; propose only this next candidate within the unchanged shared 1200 s agent budget, with EDA wait separate. Baseline Q=1 remains the best qualified result pending protected evaluation; this proposal makes no measured improvement claim.

candidates.proposal_rationale: Read the baseline, frozen protocol and all seven complete supplied artifact records. Evaluation 1 used utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=0 and both RTL actions: cell_area_um2=160081, setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439, hold_slack_ns=0.0945523, zero electrical violations, failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Evaluation 2 changed utilization to 30: cell_area_um2=163224, die_area_um2=495327, setup_slack_ns=0.230194, hold_slack_ns=0.0972317, electrical_violations={max_slew:6,max_cap:1,max_fanout:0}, failure_classes=[electrical], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Both have empty energy_j and estimated_power_w, no postprocessing commands, and no measurement_qualified or score fields; Q is unavailable for both. Passing proposal reviews established admissibility, not measured PPA success. Choose the untried configuration utilization=30, density=0.55, abc_area=0, repair_margin=20 with both RTL actions retained. Change only repair_margin to target the latest observed electrical failure while retaining its positive setup and hold slack. With one evaluation slot left, select the largest allowed repair margin to prioritize electrical qualification; violation counts alone do not reveal severity or establish that either 10 or 20 will suffice. Additional repair can increase buffering, cell area, capacitance and workload energy, consume setup headroom or alter hold timing. No raw critical-path or violating-net evidence establishes a guaranteed repair. Avoid another utilization or density change after the measured timing recovery; retain abc_area=0 to avoid additional mapping timing risk. Both RTL actions are explicitly correctness-qualified: request-gated operand isolation masks multiply inputs unless accepting a request, and exact signed 18-bit reduction is sign extended to 32 bits with unchanged registered cycle contract. They target switching and redundant arithmetic, but isolation adds gates and delay, synthesis may already optimize width, and their independent benefits have not been measured. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(Ew/Ebaseline_w) for DOT64, GEMM8 and CONV3, with baseline energies 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6 and 1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Evaluation 2 cell area is about 0.784% above baseline; even if repair added no area, its geometric-mean energy ratio would need to fall below about 0.99222 for Q<1, and repair area makes that requirement stricter. Larger floorplan and positive timing slack do not establish improvement. Protected evaluation must report configuration, rtl_actions, physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j and estimated_power_w, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical_manifest, postprocessing_commands, and physical/postprocess/total wall costs. Require frozen correctness, timing, electrical and annotation checks before ranking or comparison with Q thresholds 1.0 and 0.98. Keep period=10526 ps, two threads, Sky130HD TT25C1.8V, clock uncertainty=0.1 ns and IO delay=0.5 ns unchanged. Energy interpretation remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF over reset-deassertion to settled committed completion, without SDF-glitch or silicon-power claims. Retain both failures and costs: evaluation 1 physical/postprocess/total seconds=3156.5922685480327/4.080357030034065e-7/3156.5922689560684; evaluation 2=3487.872255544993/6.690388545393944e-7/3487.872256214032. Two of three new evaluations are captured; this proposal uses only the remaining third slot. The shared aggregate agent budget remains 1200 seconds with EDA wait separate; elapsed_search_seconds=6987.831498471962 includes EDA and supplies no remaining agent-time ledger. Baseline remains the best qualified captured result at Q=1; retain it unless this candidate passes all gates and improves measured Q. This is an unevaluated proposal, with no claimed energy or Q improvement.
